title: Code for: decision-time pilot transfer point prediction and safety-constrained relocation (RESS JRESS-D-26-03347)
description: Analysis code for the revised manuscript JRESS-D-26-03347 (Reliability Engineering & System Safety): transfer detection and pilotage-log validation, decision-time inputs at pilot-boat dispatch, model validation, and the safety-constrained meeting-point optimisation, including the multi-port extension. Licensed AIS and KMA data are not included.
